items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I told Herbinado Tate Joyce Lewis at 1111 Bermond Street... [INTERVIEWEE] yeah

ctx.x: As I remember Bob helped get it helped get him set up helped get him chosen for that Tulane concert. Could be. But I didn't go to you know I didn't know about it or something else. Yeah. I didn't have a chance to go to it.

Something could have happened. Sure. Then I have the date uh the 3rd of December 1959. It used to go back in time. 59? Or 49. Or 49. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I told Herbinado Tate Joyce Lewis at 1111 Bermond Street on Wednesday night. Oh. Now he didn't say anything about himself doing it. Yeah.
